data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1492 for the year ended 31 December 2018 is a profit of GBP 1,570,000 (2017: GBP 27,821,000 loss), of which a loss of GBP 3,735,000 is attributable to the 2018 year of account, a profit of GBP 3,930,000 is attributable to the 2017 year of account and a profit of GBP 1,375,000 is attributable to the 2016 and prior years of account.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2018 were GBP 74.985m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows net adverse movement on prior years (2016 and earlier) of approximately GBP 6.246m (about 8.3% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse claims development in the 2016 underwriting year partially offset by small favourable movement on 2015. The managing agent reports prior-year profits on 2016 & prior and 2017 years of account on a net basis, but the gross triangle indicates a modest overall strengthening of reserves on older years.
raw_causal_phrases: The calendar year has been benign with no major loss activity to date.
The 2018 year of account has run very favourably to date
loss reserve assumptions have been held at planned levels following consideration of the experience in the year.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
Other key circumstances affecting the reliability of assumptions include variation in interest rates, delays in settlement and changes in foreign currency rates.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (6.246m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 63) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2016. No explicit single gross 'movement in prior years' line item was provided; the managing agent's year-of-account breakdown quoted prior-year net profits (net of reinsurance) which were not used for the gross PYD figure. LOB movements were derived by mapping the report's printed classes to standard Lloyd's LOBs (aggregating Property-related book items into 'Property' and Financial Lines into 'Professional Lines'). Triangle and balance-sheet figures are in GBP 000 in the report; values here are converted to millions.
